description: We are three university students working on Mars Pathfinder. It's a map that helps people explore Jezero Crater on Mars, choose a landing spot, and find the best routes to interesting places. We enjoy space, technology, coding, and learning new things. We are excited to work together and build something cool!!
summary: Mars Pathfinder is an interactive mission-planning tool designed to help future explorers navigate the Martian surface safely while identifying valuable scientific destinations. Focusing on Jezero Crater, the project combines terrain elevation data with slope and surface roughness analysis to assess landing-site suitability and compare potential rover routes. Users can explore scientific sites, evaluate candidate landing locations, and generate routes that balance terrain safety, travel distance, and scientific value. By integrating planetary data into a practical mapping interface, Mars Pathfinder aims to make complex Martian terrain information easier to understand and support more informed exploration decisions.
details:
Mars Pathfinder – Interactive Martian Terrain and Route Analysis

Mars Pathfinder is an interactive mapping and terrain-analysis tool designed to support safer and more informed exploration of Jezero Crater on Mars.

The project combines an interactive map with scientific terrain data to help users explore potential landing locations, assess terrain conditions, and compare possible rover routes to scientific targets.

Our analysis engine processes a high-resolution 20-meter-per-pixel CTX Digital Elevation Model (DEM). It derives terrain slope and surface roughness, then combines these factors into preliminary landing-suitability classifications: More Suitable, Caution, and Unsuitable.

Users can select a starting location and a scientific destination. The route-planning engine uses an A* search algorithm to generate and compare candidate paths while considering terrain difficulty and avoiding areas classified as unsuitable.

The project also incorporates scientific target locations around Jezero Crater, helping connect terrain analysis with the scientific objectives of Mars exploration.

Technology: Python for terrain analysis and route planning, and JavaScript-based web technologies for the interactive map and user interface.

Mars Pathfinder aims to make planetary terrain data easier to explore and understand through an accessible visual tool. Its suitability classifications are preliminary decision-support estimates, not certified landing-site safety assessments.
